question: Let X and Y have the joint p.m.f f(x, y) = (x+y)/(21), where x = 1, 2, 3 and y = 1, 2. The marginal p.m.f of x is:
solution:

• **Option 1: 2x+321,x=1,2,3" id="MathJax-Element-444-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">2x+321,x=1,2,32x+321,x=1,2,3" id="MathJax-Element-256-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">2x+321,x=1,2,32x+321,x=1,2,3
 2x+321,x=1,2,3
 \rm \frac{2x+3}{21}, x=1,2,3 **
 
 
• The marginal p.m.f. of x is found by summing the joint p.m.f over all possible values of y.
 
• For x = 1: 1+121+1+221=221+321=521" id="MathJax-Element-445-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">1+121+1+221=221+321=5211+121+1+221=221+321=521" id="MathJax-Element-257-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">1+121+1+221=221+321=5211+121+1+221=221+321=521
 1+121+1+221=221+321=521
 \frac{1+1}{21} + \frac{1+2}{21} = \frac{2}{21} + \frac{3}{21} = \frac{5}{21}
 
• For x = 2: 2+121+2+221=321+421=721" id="MathJax-Element-446-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">2+121+2+221=321+421=7212+121+2+221=321+421=721" id="MathJax-Element-258-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">2+121+2+221=321+421=7212+121+2+221=321+421=721
 2+121+2+221=321+421=721
 \frac{2+1}{21} + \frac{2+2}{21} = \frac{3}{21} + \frac{4}{21} = \frac{7}{21}
 
• For x = 3: 3+121+3+221=421+521=921" id="MathJax-Element-447-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">3+121+3+221=421+521=9213+121+3+221=421+521=921" id="MathJax-Element-259-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">3+121+3+221=421+521=9213+121+3+221=421+521=921

 \frac{3+1}{21} + \frac{3+2}{21} = \frac{4}{21} + \frac{5}{21} = \frac{9}{21}
 
• Thus, the marginal p.m.f. of x is 2x+321" id="MathJax-Element-448-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">2x+3212x+321" id="MathJax-Element-260-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">2x+3212x+321

 \frac{2x+3}{21} , which matches the correct option.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: 6+3y21,y=1,2" id="MathJax-Element-449-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">6+3y21,y=1,26+3y21,y=1,2" id="MathJax-Element-261-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">6+3y21,y=1,26+3y21,y=1,2

• This option incorrectly uses y instead of x for the marginal p.m.f. of x.
 
• The marginal p.m.f. should be a function of x only, not y.
 
• This does not correctly represent the sum of the joint p.m.f over y.

• This option does not correctly sum the joint p.m.f over y.
 
• The terms do not match the correct values calculated for the marginal p.m.f of x.
 
• This option incorrectly inflates the values of the marginal probabilities.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: 6x+321,x=1,2,3" id="MathJax-Element-451-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">6x+321,x=1,2,36x+321,x=1,2,3" id="MathJax-Element-263-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">6x+321,x=1,2,36x+321,x=1,2,3

• This option incorrectly multiplies the coefficients of x by 6.
 
• The correct marginal p.m.f. should not have such a large coefficient for x.
 
• It does not match the summation results of the joint p.m.f over y.
